scenario: Underscore digit-group separators per LLEX.11.1 — `1_000`, `0xFF_FF`, and `0b1010_1010` are valid integer literals. Pin: a where clause using all three forms compiles OK.
rules_ds:
schema Flags scope logical:
    a: Int key
    b: Int mutable
    c: Int mutable

rule r:
    Flags f where f.a == 1_000 and f.b == 0xFF_FF and f.c == 0b1010_1010
->
    log info "ok"
